name: gate_up_lora_b
description: Per-segment LoRA B update for gated MLP weights. For each segment b, rows are taken from x (optionally permuted by batch_info.permutation), split into gate/up halves of rank r, multiplied by gate_up_lora_b[adapter,:,:] with float32 accumulation, scaled by batch_info.scalings[adapter], and added to base_output. Segments with lora_ranks[adapter]==0 leave base_output unchanged. batch_info is a dataclass carrying seg_indptr, weight_indices, lora_ranks, scalings and optional permutation. Shapes: x [S,2r], weights [L,2*output_dim,r], base_output [S,2*output_dim]. Returns a new tensor; base_output is read-only. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with r 16..64, output_dim 64..4096, zero-length segments and shuffled permutation.
